pcap_intf.description: Network interface fwknopd sniffs for SPA packets (e.g. eth0, ens3, bond0)

pcap_filter.description: libpcap BPF filter expression; restrict to the SPA UDP port to reduce CPU load

enable_pcap_promisc.description: Enable promiscuous mode on the capture interface; normally not required for single-host SPA

pcap_loop_sleep.description: Microseconds to sleep between pcap_loop iterations; lower values reduce latency but increase CPU use

max_sniff_bytes.description: Maximum bytes inspected per captured packet; 1500 safely covers any standard SPA payload

max_spa_packet_age.description: Seconds; SPA packets with an older embedded timestamp are dropped as potential replays

enable_spa_packet_aging.description: Enforce the max_spa_packet_age timestamp check; set false only for testing without NTP sync

enable_digest_persistence.description: Write seen packet digests to disk so replay attacks are blocked across daemon restarts

digest_file.description: Absolute path to the file where SPA packet digests are stored

enable_spa_over_http.description: Accept SPA payloads embedded in HTTP request bodies; requires the client to use --http-proxy mode

enable_tcp_server.description: Run a decoy TCP listener that accepts and drops connections to disguise the knock port

tcpserv_port.description: TCP port the decoy listener binds on; only effective when enable_tcp_server is true

gpg_home_dir.description: GnuPG home directory containing the server private key; leave empty to use pre-shared-key (Rijndael) mode only

enable_ipt_forwarding.description: Allow fwknopd to insert FORWARD chain rules; enable for VPN gateways or hosts that route traffic

enable_ipt_local_nat.description: Allow DNAT rules redirecting inbound traffic to a local port; useful for single-packet NAT scenarios

enable_ipt_output.description: Insert OUTPUT chain rules in addition to INPUT when granting a client access

enable_ipt_conntrack_input.description: Add a RELATED,ESTABLISHED conntrack rule to INPUT; required for correct TCP session teardown through the firewall

pid_file.description: Absolute path where fwknopd writes its PID; used by systemd and init scripts for process management

syslog_identity.description: Program name tag that appears in every syslog / journald log line from this daemon

syslog_facility.description: Syslog facility for log messages (LOG_DAEMON, LOG_LOCAL0 through LOG_LOCAL7)

verbose.description: Logging verbosity level: 0 = normal operation, 1 = verbose SPA processing detail, 2+ = full debug output
